description: GLM-5.3-Flash model regression tests (tools/glm_regression.py). Paths can be overridden with STRATA_GLM_TEST_MODEL, STRATA_GLM_TEST_PACK, STRATA_GLM_TEST_EVAL_REFERENCE; tests exit 77 (skipped) when the files are missing.

short_context.golden_note: greedy canonical decode on tr16 2026-10-09 (glm53f after the 0.1.41 merge); identical with replay, verify, decode-graph checks, MTP2 split verify and an adaptive 2 GiB tier

known_failures.check_prefill: batched GPU prefill KDA state differs from sequential by 11-14 % relative L2 (limit 2 %) in 124 buffers; same with the pre-merge e5 decoder; greedy token equal

baseline.build: glm53f after the upstream 0.1.41 merge (b6e9919f + uncommitted engine work); 523 s on tr16; matches the documented q23 0.137 / 87.7 % / 4.825

quality.note: baseline is the q23 pack in canonical mode over the 16 held-out sequences; the reference file holds more sequences than the corpus, so the decoder's 'trailing evaluation baseline records' exit is expected
quality.tolerance_note: the evaluation is bit-for-bit repeatable in canonical mode (three runs on 2026-10-09 gave the same KL, nll and different_logits count); the limits only absorb intended rounding changes. They catch route affinity 0.05 (KL 0.143). Re-record the baseline after an intended quality change.
